compute_squad_v2_scores: compute SQuAD v2 exact match and F1 scores for question-answering predictions against references
evaluate_squad_v2_metric: evaluate a SquadV2 metric with predictions containing id, prediction_text, and no_answer_probability
apply_no_ans_threshold: apply a no-answer probability threshold to filter exact match and F1 raw scores
find_all_best_thresh: find the optimal no-answer probability threshold that maximizes exact match and F1 scores
get_raw_scores: get raw exact match and F1 scores by comparing predicted answers against gold answers
